brief: Hydrophone H-2 detected a likely right whale up-call with a confidence of 1.00, and a 10 nm slow zone was set around it. Nordic Tide reduced speed from 16 to 10 knots, Harbor Queen slowed from 22 to 10 knots, Blue Fin II decreased from 11 to 9 knots, and Cape Runner adjusted from 19 to 17 knots, achieving 75% compliance. Cape Runner should be contacted to ensure full compliance with the slow zone, noting that all vessel data is simulated and the detection clip is a synthetic demo clip.
